sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through layers of connection, but if any link is missing, the whole attempt quietly resolves to nothing.

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sending on a channel with no receiver blocks forever (deadlock)
sketches.resonance: A voice that speaks into a channel no one is listening to will wait forever — the runtime itself declares this fatal.

sketches.mechanism: The type `IO ()` — an action that interacts with the world but produces nothing
sketches.resonance: Sometimes the whole point of reaching out into the world is not to get something back.
sketches.draft:
module Touch where

touch :: IO ()
touch = return ()
